rev.summary:
I reviewed fix7-desk (3 commits on e5356d4). The backend tests pass on a throwaway database: test_00_startup, test_ws_circle, test_surface and test_access gave 597 passed, and the neighbouring files (campaigns, circle_rest, rest_broadcasts, ws_character, ws_rolls, ws_timer) gave 374 passed. vite build passes. I checked the desk in Chromium at 1440x900, 1440x761, 1280x720, 1366x768, 1180, 1024 and 820x1180 (tablet). Commit trailers are right, and there are no em dashes or model names. Every claimed item is in the diff.

Three things should be fixed before merge:
1. **Earn-backs on existing circles (69.3).** `milestones_earned` starts at 0 for circles that already exist. On those, a fall past a milestone no longer takes a waiting earn-back away, and the next rise counts it again. I reproduced this: illumination 7 with one earn-back waiting, falling to 5 and rising back to 7 ends with 2 waiting; the old code ended with 1. That is worse than before the fix, on the very path it was meant to fix.
2. **End Assignment still moves when armed (45.5).** At 1440x900, 1440x761 and 1280x720 the stamp drops about 56px (y 777 to 833 at 1440x900). The idle "End Assignment" label wraps Dispatch onto a second row; the armed "End" label is short enough for both to share one row. The floating hint's Keep going button then lands under the pointer.
3. **Dispatch receipt hidden.** From xl the stamp row is sticky and sits after the receipt, so the receipt ("Dispatched at ...", or the "Not sent" alert) is covered by the stamp row or below the screen.

A withdrawn request's note (45.7) also sticks: if the same investigator asks again, its sheet still says "no longer waiting" and has no Approve or Reject (reproduced). Smaller issues are FAQ.md and RULES_CHECK.md text that is now out of date, and a Finalize confirm that runs to about 30 words.

issues.problem: For every circle that exists when the column is added (and for a circle that gains Resource Management partway along the track), milestones_earned is 0 while illumination may already be past 3, 6 or 9. A fall past a milestone then keeps the waiting earn-back, because of the check `m <= counted_to and waiting > 0`, and the rise back counts the milestone again. Reproduced with _count_earn_backs: illumination 7, earn_backs 1, milestones_earned 0. Falling 7 to 5 leaves earn_backs at 1 (the old code made it 0). Rising 5 to 7 makes it 2. That is the double count 69.3 was meant to remove, and it breaks the FAQ rule that taking the track back past a milestone takes the earn-back away.
issues.fix: Make the highest milestone at or below old_illum count as already counted: `counted_to = max(circle.milestones_earned or 0, max([m for m in MILESTONES if m <= old_illum], default=0))`. The other option is to backfill the column in init_db when it is added (CASE on illumination). Add a test for a circle with illumination 7, earn_backs 1 and milestones_earned 0 that falls to 5 and rises back to 7.

issues.problem: 45.5 is not fixed at the sizes it targets. From xl the letter column is narrow enough that idle 'End Assignment' and 'Dispatch' wrap onto two rows. Armed, the label shrinks to 'End', both fit on one row, and End drops about 56px: y 777 to 833 at 1440x900, 638 to 694 at 1440x761, 597 to 653 at 1280x720. The floating hint's 'Keep going' button (about y 775 to 813 at 1440x900) now sits where the pointer pressed. The report says the stamp's vertical position holds when armed; it does not.
issues.fix: Keep the row from reflowing when it arms. From xl, keep the 'End Assignment' label when armed, or give the End stamp a fixed min-width matching its idle width. Another way is to lay the two stamps out so the label width cannot change the wrap, for example Dispatch always on its own row from xl. Recheck at 1440x900, 1440x761 and 1280x720 that the End box's y is unchanged after arming.

issues.problem: With `xl:order-last xl:sticky` the stamp row now sits after the receipt (`receipt`, role status or alert), the form line and 'On the players' desks / Not dispatched yet' in the layout. The Lightkeeper can now press Dispatch without scrolling, and the receipt then lands under the sticky row or below the column. At 1440x900 'Dispatched at 12:19 PM.' sat at y 810 to 832, covered by the stamps; at 1280x720 it was at y 994, off screen. A 'Not sent: the desk is not connected...' alert would be just as hidden, so the Lightkeeper could believe a dispatch went out when it did not.
issues.fix: From xl, put the receipt (and the dispatched status) inside the sticky row, under or beside the stamps. The other option is to scroll the receipt into view when it changes, while keeping it inside the row so the stamps do not move.

issues.problem: goneId is never cleared. A withdrawn request can be asked again with the same investigator (withdraw sets it back to unaffiliated with the same id). Reproduced: Bram withdraws while his sheet is open, the Lightkeeper goes Back to requests, Bram joins again, and View sheet shows "BRAM OKONKWO-HALLOWAY'S REQUEST IS NO LONGER WAITING." with no Approve or Reject while the tab shows 1 waiting. The same happens if the sheet stays open while he asks again.
issues.fix: In the effect, when the selected id is back in pending_investigators, clear goneId (`if (waiting.some(...)) { if (goneId === selectedInvestigator.id) setGoneId(null); return; }`). Also clear it when a sheet is opened (handleSelectInvestigator and viewRequest).

issues.problem: The FAQ still says 'with one point missing a tally passing 3 and 6 earns one, and the second milestone's line says there is nothing more to earn back'. There is now a single line ending '; the rest have nowhere to go, as what is waiting already fills its resources'. RULES_CHECK.md:160 still says 'Each milestone the illumination passes gets its own log line' and 'with its milestone lines'. These files describe behaviour as implemented.
issues.fix: Update the FAQ sentence to describe the one Resource Management line. Add a dated note under RULES_CHECK item 19/20 saying milestones are logged only in the Resource Management line (fix round 7, 45.3).

issues.problem: With every part empty and a waiting request, the armed line is 'Press again to seal the circle for good with 1 investigator, leaving the circle question, the insignia, the circle ability and the name empty and turning away 1 waiting request.' That is about 30 words, with two 'and's that blur where the list ends. DESIGN.md and decision 2 ask for one short sentence.
issues.fix: Shorten the empty-parts clause when several parts are empty, e.g. 'leaving 4 parts empty' with the names behind the existing armedInfo 'i', or use a semicolon-free form such as '..., leaving 4 parts unchosen, and turn away 1 waiting request.'

issues.problem: At 1280x720 a strip of letter text ('church.') shows below the sticky stamp row. Sticky bottom-0 sits inside the column's xl:pb-3 padding, so the content scrolls through the gap under the stamps.
issues.fix: Offset the sticky bottom by the column's padding (e.g. xl:bottom-[-0.75rem]), or extend the row's paper below it with a pseudo-element or a larger negative bottom margin plus padding.

issues.problem: The 'Since fix round 7' sentence about clearing the timer is spliced into the middle of the 2026-10-07/2026-10-08 parenthetical, and it has no date where the other notes have one. DESIGN.md has no entry for the new sticky stamp row or floating armed-hint pattern, which the triage expected.
issues.fix: Move it to its own '(Since 2026-10-13, fix round 7: ...)' parenthetical at the end. Optionally add a DESIGN.md line for the sticky stamp row.

issues.problem: socketReady is read once per render from socket.readyState and is not reactive. If the socket drops without the store replacing it, the strip's -, + and Start buttons stay enabled and send() does nothing, with no message. SceneManager's tension buttons behave the same way, so this matches existing code.
issues.fix: Optional: read the store's connection flag (the one the ConnectionBanner uses) instead of readyState.

issues.problem: The new Chapter House status line reads `house`, which is never defined (only houseDraft and houseSent were added). Focusing the Chapter House box sets houseDraft, the render throws `ReferenceError: house is not defined`, and the whole screen is replaced by 'This page stopped working'. I reproduced it in Chromium on a formation table: focus the box and the desk crashes. Any player on an unsealed circle hits this on the first click into the box. 60.18 was only built, not opened, so it was never seen.
issues.fix: Define `const house = backstoryAnswers.chapter_house ?? '';` next to the other derived values and use it in the status expression. Then open the popup in a browser and check blank, typing, blur and Saved.

issues.problem: The store writes backstoryAnswers.chapter_house optimistically before sending, and sends only if the socket is open. 'Saved' therefore shows as soon as the box is blurred, even with the socket down or the server refusing, because stored equals sent. The line does not say what it claims. The location suggestion buttons (line 431) also write the chapter house without setting houseSent, so the line stays blank or stale after a tap.
issues.fix: Accept as detection only, or show 'Saved' only while the connection is open, and set houseSent in the suggestion buttons' handler too.

issues.problem: 60.16 asked for the skip link at the top of the sheet. It is the 3rd Tab stop on a phone and the 6th on tablet and laptop (I measured 3 on a phone). The 12-Tab complaint is much better, but not a first-stop link. The QUIRKS line says 'first stop of the player's sheet after the desk header', which is true only of the sheet's own content.
